```{r setup}
library(GimmmeMySC)
```

# Transfer learning
```{r}
wt@meta.data[, "labels"] <- Idents(wt)
# wt@assays$SCT@scale.data <- matrix()
# ko@assays$SCT@scale.data <- matrix()
seurat <- merge(wt, y = ko)
```

```{r}
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
    reference = wt,
    query = seurat,
    # normalization.method = "SCT",
    reference.reduction = "pca",
    # reference.reduction = integration_method,
    dims = seq(n_dim)
)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
cl_trans <- TransferData(
    anchorset = anchors,
    dims = seq(n_dim),
    # weight.reduction = KO[[integration_method]],
    refdata = Idents(wt)
  )
seurat <- AddMetaData(seurat, metadata = cl_trans)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
wt2 <- RunUMAP(
  wt,
  dims = seq(n_dim),
  # reduction = integration_method,
  reduction = "pca",
  return.model = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
seurat <- MapQuery(
    anchorset = anchors,
    query = seurat,
    reference = wt,
    refdata = list(labels = "labels"),
    # reference.reduction = integration_method,
    reduction.model = "umap"
)
```

```{r}
plot_sc_violin(
    seurat,
    features = paste0("prediction.score.", levels(Idents(wt))),
    cols = GimmeMyPlot:::palette_discrete(),
    nrow = 3
)
```

```{r}
type <- NULL
seurat$predicted.labels<- factor(seurat$predicted.labels, levels = 0: (length(unique(seurat$predicted.labels)) - 1))
Idents(seurat) <- "predicted.labels"
DimPlot(
    object = seurat, 
    label = TRUE,
    # cols = GimmeMyPlot:::palette_continuous(gray = FALSE)(length(levels(Idents(seurat)))),
    cols = GimmeMyPlot:::palette_discrete(),
    repel = TRUE,
    na.value = "white",
    split.by = "Type",
    # group.by = ,
    reduction = "ref.umap",
    pt.size = 1,
    alpha = 0.25
) %>% 
    theme_sc_dim() + ggtitle(type) + NoLegend()
```
